cards.title: Ornith
cards.note: Must stay ABOVE the apex card: match() takes the first hit and this file's quants are named ...-APEX. deepreinforce-ai/Ornith-1.0-35B is a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B derivative (arch qwen35moe, identical dims/tokenizer), so the numbers follow the Qwen3.6 card — but temp/top_p/top_k here are the model's OWN embedded sampling hints, not inherited. presence is 0: SC117's 1.5 is documented for their Qwen3.6 APEX, not for this base, and no Ornith card was consulted. No-thinking profile is inferred from the Qwen3.6 instruct guidance.

cards.title: APEX
cards.note: Its thinking profile asks for presence_penalty 1.5, unlike the other two Qwen cards which ask for 0 — following each card as written.

cards.title: Qwen3.6 (heretic-v2 / Fable-Fus)
cards.note: Same Qwen3.6 base guidance. DavidAU adds, for MTP quants: keep temp <= 1 and repeat-penalty at 1.0 (off) — do not "fix" repetition here by raising it. Instruct profile is inferred for Fable, whose card only documents thinking.

cards.title: Cydonia
cards.note: TheDrummer publishes no sampler settings for Cydonia — the card gives only the Mistral v7 Tekken template and "thinking works, no thinking also works". Unset knobs (top_p, top_k, presence) keep the script default.
